items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: They had a Thomas. I think Thomas started with them. I think he did. If I'm not mistaken.

ctx.x: And who did he play with?

Well, they had a little band my brother played with them. They had a Thomas. I think Thomas started with them. I think he did. If I'm not mistaken. My brother played the violin. And he played the bass. And one of the man in my band played trombone. The same trombone player I have. Blassey. They all younger than I was. They were younger than I was. And then he moved to the city.
Where is Dave from? What town?
